_comment: PROG-1027 user-facing progress labels (only place for stage and terminal text). Placeholders: {rid} request id (shown by design), {minutes} (terminals only; derived from ASK_TIMEOUT_S, rounded up, includes the unit word), counts {admitted} {found} {checked} {usable} {budget} {stored} {target} {attempt}. Labels name no gate, layer, provider, category, verdict code, basis or source. Counts are shown only when the event carries them. STREAM-1031 additions: counts {shortlisted} {held} {step} {ceiling} and {why_text} (rendered from the top-level why map by the client). Generic wording only: counts and stages, never a provider, portal, host, URL or title.
progress_unavailable: Live progress is not available right now; still waiting for the answer
reload_caption: Keep this tab open; reloading starts over
already_running: A question is already being answered; ask again when it finishes
background_line: VERA-DAR will keep looking for sources on this topic after this answer

corpus.skipped: Collection search not available this time

corpus_verdict.insufficient: The collection does not have enough evidence yet
corpus_verdict.stale: Some of the collection's evidence may not be current; checking for newer sources

acquire.start: Reading full-text documents (this request can add up to {budget})
acquire.update: Checked {checked} of {shortlisted} · {usable} usable · {held} held back for licence · {stored} of {target} saved
acquire.skipped: No new documents read this time
acquire.busy: VERA-DAR is busy; try again shortly

write.start: Writing the answer from the usable passages
write.update: Writing the answer from the usable passages

check.start: Checking each claim against its sources
check.update: Checking each claim against its sources

terminals.partial: Partial answer: some parts lacked usable evidence
terminals.no_answer: No answer: not enough usable evidence yet
terminals.error: Something went wrong; please try again
terminals.provider_error: The answer could not be generated right now; please try again shortly
terminals.busy: VERA-DAR is busy right now; please try again shortly
terminals.expired: The service restarted while answering; please ask again
terminals.poll_timeout_received: Still working after {minutes}. The server may still finish; ask again later (request {rid})
terminals.poll_timeout_unreceived: No reply after {minutes}; please ask again later (request {rid})
terminals.unavailable: The answering service is at its limit right now; please try again later
terminals.connection_lost: The connection was interrupted. Documents VERA-DAR already saved stay in its collection; ask again to use them.
terminals.never_connected: Could not reach VERA-DAR; please try again shortly
terminals.stalled: VERA-DAR stopped searching because no further progress was made; documents already saved stay in its collection.
terminals.orphaned: This page stopped receiving updates, so the request was closed. Documents VERA-DAR already saved stay in its collection; ask again to use them.
terminals.cancelled: The request was cancelled before it finished. Documents VERA-DAR already saved stay in its collection; ask again to use them.

why.5: the answering service is at its limit

activities.1: Waiting about {wait_s} s for a search provider's rate limit
activities.2: Waiting about {wait_s} s between requests to a source, to be polite to it
activities.3: Still reading {k} source(s) at once; the slowest has taken {elapsed} s
activities.4: A step failed; trying again in about {wait_s} s
activities.5: Free AI providers are busy; finishing with backup
activities.8: Preparing a reading list from the sources found ({elapsed} s)
